name: Rábapaty (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue and yellow triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábapaty: a crowned blue shield with a white bend, a yellow lion and reeds.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of blue and yellow triangles
